citation: 403 for a token that authenticated but lacks the required scope — RFC 6750 §3.1 (insufficient_scope) and RFC 9110 §15.5.4 (403); module 06 §4.2/§4.3 authn-vs-authz distinction ("403 almost always means your token authenticated fine but lacks the scope"); { error, message } shape (§5.1).
notes: Auth ladder: 401-vs-403 split. <scope> is the endpoint's required scope (here users:read).
